IC1: - Participant with moderate to severe Hidradenitis Suppurativa (HS) for at least one year prior to Baseline visit.
IC2: - HS lesions present in at least two distinct anatomical areas.
IC3: - Draining fistula count of <=20 at Baseline visit.
IC4: - Total abscesses and nodule count (AN count) of >= 5 at Baseline visit.
IC5: - Participants are required to use a daily antiseptic wash on their HS lesions .
IC6: - Participant must have a history of inadequate response [OR] or intolerance to an adequate trial of oral antibiotics for treatment of HS.
